rationale: The agent executed return actions on two orders without any explicit user confirmation, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The conversation shows no clear authentication step beyond a lookup by email, and no user-facing verification that the orders/items belong to the user. There is no summary of what was returned or the refund methods used; the only visible final message is a generic farewell. While tool calls suggest the agent identified the user and orders and initiated returns (including differing refund methods), the lack of explicit confirmation and final information contravenes the policy, so the task was not completed in line with requirements.
